description.en: Section titles come from Tap (valve); the concrete pump split piston φ180 figures stay the printed ones. A φ180 split piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai split-piston page. It is sold as a set. The materials printed for this row are rubber and polyurethane. directAnswer.en: The short answer for concrete pump split piston φ180 uses the cells Xingtai already printed. Tap (valve) is the outline those cells are filed under. A φ180 split piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai split-piston page. It is sold as a set. The materials printed for this row are rubber and polyurethane. No published pump page assigns φ180 to a model.
directAnswer.zh: concrete pump split piston φ180的简答只用邢台已经印出的格子。《Tap (valve)》是这些格子所依的大纲。 φ180 分体活塞是邢台分体活塞页上的一条外径。按套供货。这一行印出的材料是橡胶和聚氨酯。没有任何已公布泵页把 φ180 指定到某一型号。

body.en: The contents list of the source page includes “Nomenclature”. This section borrows that name and then repeats a printed fragment. The split piston is a replacement set for S-valve concrete pumps, supplied from Xingtai by Hebei Pinjin Machinery. The full outer-diameter list is φ150, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ220, φ230, φ250, φ260 and φ280. This note is only the φ180 row, materials: rubber and polyurethane. Unit: set. The page does not print a compound grade, a hardness, or a service life. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. The integral-piston page is a different part. Where the same φ180 also appears there, it is still not a pump-model assignment. Electric 20's 80 mm figure is a pipe inner diameter, not a piston outer diameter. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Write split piston, φ180, the material row (rubber and polyurethane), and the quantity in sets. Leave life and pump model blank if the machine check is not done. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: 来源页目录里有“术语”。本节借用这个名字，然后复述已经印出的片段。 分体活塞是河北品锦机械从邢台供应的 S 阀混凝土泵替换套件。全部外径是 φ150, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ220, φ230, φ250, φ260 and φ280。本文只写 φ180 这一行，材料：橡胶和聚氨酯。单位：套。页面没有印胶料牌号、硬度或寿命。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 整体活塞是另一件配件。若同一个 φ180 也出现在那边，仍然不是泵型号的指定。电动20的 80 mm 是输送管内径，不是活塞外径。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 写明分体活塞、φ180、材料行（橡胶和聚氨酯）和套数。若还没在机器上核对，寿命和泵型号留空。 大纲补不上空白格子。

body.en: “Types” is a heading on the crawled page, used here only as the section name. It does not create a measurement. A φ180 split piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai split-piston page. It is sold as a set. The materials printed for this row are rubber and polyurethane. No published pump page assigns φ180 to a model. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row.
body.zh: “类型”是抓到的那一页自己的章节名，这里只拿来当标题，不另造一个测量值。 φ180 分体活塞是邢台分体活塞页上的一条外径。按套供货。这一行印出的材料是橡胶和聚氨酯。没有任何已公布泵页把 φ180 指定到某一型号。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 不把旁边那一页的数字抄到这一行。

body.en: Use “Physics” to see where this block sits in the source article. The purchasing sentence is the printed fragment, not the encyclopedia prose. A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row.
body.zh: 用“物理”看这一节在来源文章中的位置。采购时要抄的是已印片段，不是百科正文。 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 不把旁边那一页的数字抄到这一行。

body.en: The heading “Mechanisms” is structural. What it is allowed to carry is the wording already on the row for this note. The page calls them Xingtai replacement wear parts, not OEM parts of other pump brands. Email or WhatsApp Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai, and name the 分体活塞 page plus this size and the quantity. The heading stops there. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tap_(valve)
body.zh: 标题“来源章节：Mechanisms”只起骨架作用。它能够携带的，是这篇笔记对应那一行已经印出的文字。 页面写的是邢台替换易损件，不是其他泵品牌的原厂件。 用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给邢台河北品锦机械，写明分体活塞这一页、这一尺寸和数量。 标题到此为止。 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tap_(valve)
